unit.why: A deathbed narrative of the tzaddik: in his last moments he loudly recites the Ten Commandments and Shema, sends his wife out, and performs the Ari's yihudim before his soul departs.
unit.boundary_note: part of a biographical sequence; the previous division (testament written on Hoshana Rabba, foretold death) leads into this death scene

stories.start_quote: סיפר לי חותני הרב הקדוש שליט״א כי
stories.end_quote: היו שנותיו בערך נ"ז שנה זיע"א
stories.summary_en: The author's father-in-law relates that moments before his death the tzaddik loudly recited the Ten Commandments and Shema; his weeping wife came in, and he sent her out because he was performing the Ari's yihudim for the last moments, then his soul ascended on 7 Marheshvan 608.
